judgement.reason: Outcome DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is not too lenient: the dbgate web client is an HTTP app, and the compose proxy service is for testing only.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yaml defines 2 application services (dbgate, proxy). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The compose file is a local test stack, and the production Dockerfile builds and starts only the single dbgate web process.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /root/.dbgate (docker/Dockerfile), volume dbgate-data:/root/.dbgate (docker-compose.yaml dbgate)
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile declares a volume at /root/.dbgate, and no shown setting moves the connections and settings stored there to a managed datastore.
